init.title: Venice AI Options
init.description: Configure Venice AI conversation, voice, and model settings.

data_description.chat_model: Only models with function calling support are shown.
data_description.temperature: Controls randomness — higher values produce more varied responses (0–2).
data_description.top_p: Nucleus sampling threshold — lower values focus on likely tokens (0–1).
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum tokens the model may generate per response.
data_description.strip_thinking_response: Remove reasoning blocks from the output before showing the response. For reasoning models.
data_description.disable_thinking: Skip the internal reasoning step entirely, trading depth for speed. For reasoning models.
data_description.continue_conversation: Keep the microphone open after a response that ends with a question.
data_description.enable_web_search: Allow Venice AI to search the web when answering questions.
data_description.max_tool_iterations: How many tool-call rounds the agent may run per message before stopping.
data_description.context_threshold: Remove older messages when the conversation exceeds this many tokens.
data_description.tts_enabled: Register Venice as a TTS provider for the voice assistant pipeline.
data_description.stt_enabled: Register Venice as a speech-to-text provider for the voice assistant pipeline.
data_description.stt_timestamps: Return word-level timestamps in the transcription response.
